headline: US economic outlook June 2026: GDP 1.8%, core inflation above 3%, jobs growth moderating
summary: EY's June 2026 US economic outlook projects real GDP growth of 1.8% for 2026, with core inflation year-end estimates upgraded above 3% due to sticky services inflation, tariff pass-through, energy price increases from the Iran conflict, and potential AI category inflation overstatement.
key_facts: US real GDP 2026 forecast: 1.8%
Core inflation end-2026 estimate above 3%
Drivers: sticky services, tariff pass-through, energy (Iran conflict), AI inflation
Average monthly payroll growth moderating to ~70K per month in 2026
Unemployment rate drifting modestly higher
Q1 2026 GDP growth: 2.0% annualized (rebounding from 0.5% Q4 2025)

headline: KOSPI remains world's best-performing major index despite selloff, up ~100% YTD heading into June 24
summary: Despite the June 23 circuit-breaker event and 10% single-day decline, South Korea's KOSPI remained the best-performing major stock index in the world with year-to-date gains of approximately 100%, driven by the AI semiconductor boom centered on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
key_facts: KOSPI up ~100% YTD (world's best-performing major index)
KOSPI at 8,471 after June 24 rebound
Prior session: KOSPI -9.99% to 8,203.84
Samsung and SK Hynix at center of AI memory boom driving gains
KOSPI has triggered circuit breakers twice this month
